info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Deletions API
Delete one or more Payment Cards (to be deprecated)

items.docs:
Allows a registered Service Provider to delete one or more Payment Cards from its profile. Any data associated with a requested paymentCardId will also be deleted permanently.

On the successful response from the server, a Service Provider should remove all the requested paymentCardIds from the system.

Once a request has been received from a Service Provider, data deletion will happen immediately.

info.name: Mastercard Delete One or More Users.

items.docs:
• Allows a registered Service Provider to delete one or more users.
  • Payment cards associated with the user will also be deleted.
  • On a successful response from the Server, the Service Provider should remove all the requested users and associated payment cards from the system.

Delete an identity attribute from a PDS and update the affected assurance levels. Requires GPA authentication.   
**This API is mandatory.**
